basics.name: Jordan Naccache (Ethan)
basics.summary: Cryptography researcher specializing in symmetric-key cryptography and post-quantum security.

work.name: SnT, the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust
work.summary: Research in post-quantum cryptography with the APSIA team led by Prof. Peter Y. A. Ryan.

work.name: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
highlights: Conducted in-depth analysis of symmetric-key schemes, including (Tweakable) Block Ciphers and Authenticated Encryption Schemes.
Developed provable security models for PRF-based constructions in the quantum setting, introducing novel proof frameworks.

work.name: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev (BGU)
highlights: Research in the field of Cryptoanalysis and Algorithm design.
Implementation of cryptographic algorithms in Sage and C++.

work.name: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev
